{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gankto tree''' was native to [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. [[Arblis Forest]] was primarily composed of Ganktos.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

It had a grey trunk that reached 12 [[meter/Legends|meters]], with pale leaves. In its later stages of evolution, it had formed a pattern of growth so that only its lowest branches (1 meter off the ground) had foliage.<ref name="guide" />

Eons before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the tree's foliage was home for a [[Extinct bird species|bird species]] which nested in its upper reaches and picked clean the branches. Over time, the tree's leaves came to only grow on the lower branches, leaving the higher ones bare. But as the birds continued to nest in the lowest bush-like leaves, they were vulnerable to [[myntor]]s and other predators, until they became extinct; the tree thus had formed this pattern of growth.<ref name="guide" />

The [[Millitile/Legends|millitile]] inhabited its branches. The plant would also provide nutrition to the [[symbiospore]] [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] that covered its upper branches.<ref name="guide" />
